# SoraDialog

A modal dialog built on `<dialog>.showModal()`.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | overlays |
| Import | `import { SoraDialog } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import SoraDialog from '@your-scope/ui/components/SoraDialog'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/overlays/SoraDialog.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/overlays/SoraDialog.vue) |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` **(required)** | `string` |  | Accessible name and visible heading. |
| `description` | `string` |  | Supporting text, announced with the title. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'full'` | `'md'` | Size. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `SoraProvider` `defaults`, then to `sora.config.ts`. |
| `hideTitle` | `boolean` | `false` | Keep the title for assistive technology but hide it visually. |
| `closable` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the close button in the header. |
| `closeOnEscape` | `boolean` | `true` | Escape (and other platform close requests) may close the dialog. |
| `closeOnBackdrop` | `boolean` | `true` | A click on the backdrop may close the dialog. |
| `role` | `'dialog' \| 'alertdialog'` | `'dialog'` | `alertdialog` for interruptions that need an answer (confirmations). |
| `initialFocus` | `(() => HTMLElement \| null \| undefined)` |  | Element to focus on open. Default: `[data-autofocus]`, else the first focusable element. |
| `returnFocus` | `(() => HTMLElement \| null \| undefined)` |  | Focus target on close when the opener no longer exists (or to override it). |

## Models

| v-model | Type |  | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model:open` | `boolean` | default `false` | Whether it is open. Stays in sync with the native element, however it was opened or closed. |

## Events

| Event | Payload | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `close` | `[reason: SoraCloseReason]` | The dialog closed, with what closed it. |

## Slots

| Slot | Slot props | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default` | `props: { close: () => void }` | Dialog content. It stays mounted while closed. |
| `description` |  | Replaces the `description` text. |
| `footer` | `props: { close: () => void }` | Action row. |

## Exposed

Available on a template ref of the component.

| Member | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `close` | method | Close the dialog (same as setting `v-model:open` to `false`). |
| `element` | property | The native dialog element. |

## Attributes

The native `<dialog>`.

## Keyboard

- Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside the dialog (native modal containment).
- Escape closes it unless `closeOnEscape` is false.
- On close, focus returns to the element that opened it (or to `returnFocus`).

## Accessibility

- Native modal dialog: top layer, inert page, labelled by its title and described by its description.
- `role="alertdialog"` is available for confirmations.
- `v-model:open` stays in sync with native `cancel`/`close`, however the dialog was closed.
- Height is bounded with `dvh` and safe-area insets; the body scrolls.

## Styling

- `.sora-dialog`, `.sora-dialog__panel`, `.sora-dialog__header`, `.sora-dialog__title`, `.sora-dialog__body`, `.sora-dialog__footer`
- `data-size`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/OverlaysDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/OverlaysDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
  <SoraButton variant="outline" color="neutral" data-testid="dialog-open" @click="dialogOpen = true">{{
    t('demo.dialog.open')
  }}</SoraButton>
  <SoraButton variant="outline" color="error" data-testid="confirm-open" @click="confirmOpen = true">{{
    t('demo.delete')
  }}</SoraButton>
</div>
<SoraDialog
  v-model:open="dialogOpen"
  :title="t('demo.dialog.title')"
  :description="t('demo.dialog.description')"
>
  <div class="grid gap-3">
    <SoraInput v-model="workspace" :label="t('settings.name')" data-autofocus />
    <SoraSwitch v-model="notify" :label="t('demo.notifications')" label-placement="start" />
  </div>
  <template #footer="{ close }">
    <SoraButton variant="ghost" color="neutral" @click="close">{{ t('demo.cancel') }}</SoraButton>
    <SoraButton @click="close">{{ t('actions.done') }}</SoraButton>
  </template>
</SoraDialog>
<SoraDialog
  v-model:open="confirmOpen"
  role="alertdialog"
  size="sm"
  :title="t('demo.dialog.confirm')"
  :description="t('demo.dialog.confirm.body')"
  :closable="false"
  :close-on-backdrop="false"
>
  <template #footer="{ close }">
    <SoraButton variant="ghost" color="neutral" data-autofocus @click="close">{{
      t('demo.dialog.keep')
    }}</SoraButton>
    <SoraButton color="error" @click="close">{{ t('demo.dialog.discard') }}</SoraButton>
  </template>
</SoraDialog>
```
